# Carolina Cleaning Boys

> Carolina Cleaning Boys is a student-owned exterior cleaning company based in Greenville, North Carolina, run by East Carolina University (ECU) students. We do pressure washing, soft washing (house washing), roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, surface cleaning and window cleaning for homes and businesses across Eastern North Carolina. We have 216 five-star Google reviews (5.0 rating), we are licensed and insured, and you don't pay until you're happy with the work. Quotes are free.

## Contact

- Phone: 919-717-4653
- Email: carolinacleaningboys@gmail.com
- [Get a free quote](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/#estimate-form): online form, we reply within 24 hours

## Services

- [Pressure washing](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/pressure-washing.html): driveways, sidewalks, patios and other hard surfaces
- [Soft washing / house washing](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/soft-washing.html): low-pressure cleaning for siding, brick and stucco
- [Roof cleaning](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/roof-cleaning.html): removes black streaks, algae and moss without high pressure
- [Gutter cleaning](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/gutter-cleaning.html): gutters cleared by hand and debris hauled away
- [Surface cleaning](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/surface-cleaning.html): concrete, driveways, patios and decks
- [Window cleaning](https://carolinacleaningboys.com/services/window-cleaning.html): pure-water window cleaning. A standard cleaning covers the glass and the trim around each window; tracks and sills are an add-on

## Pricing guide

- House washing: most homes run about 20 cents a square foot, so a 2,000 sq ft house is around $400. Typical range $200 to $500. We confirm your price after we see the house.
- Every other service is quoted for free after we look at the property.
